curation_strategy: Arc obligations were satisfied first: Margaret gets 6 passages tracing her journey from displacement through psychological crisis to resolution; Thornton gets 5 passages spanning the riot through his ideological transformation; Higgins gets 4 passages covering solidarity, principle, and human cost. Expert assignments were matched to each expert's strongest dimensional demands, with Eleanor Hartley covering narrative technique and character development, James Blackstone covering social critique and atmosphere, and Caroline Woodcourt covering humor and tenderness. Eight structure passages fill the remaining dimensional gaps (character_development, social_critique x2, humor_entertainment, narrative_technique x2, thematic_depth x2), distributed across segments to respect passage-count bounds and ensure no chapter is over-represented in any single segment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Industrial Awakening: Margaret Enters the World
curation_assignments.rationale: Establishes the gothic industrial landscape of Milton as Margaret and her father arrive by rail, providing essential atmospheric grounding for the episode's opening.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Industrial Awakening: Margaret Enters the World
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's cramped, fog-shrouded bedroom contrasted with Edith's luxurious Corfu life marks her initial displacement and longing — a key opening beat in her transformation arc.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Industrial Awakening: Margaret Enters the World
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's frightened yet fascinated encounter with bold mill workers dramatises her first real contact with the industrial working class and seeds her transformation.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: The gathering crowd on Marlborough Street creates the gothic, socially charged atmosphere of the riot's approach, anchoring Thornton's reckoning with industrial violence.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: The eerie silence of the stopped mill followed by the distant roar delivers Blackstone's required atmosphere_setting and social_critique of industrial conflict at fever pitch.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Thornton's passionate denunciation of the crowd for their cowardly violence against Margaret is the moral and dramatic climax of the riot, central to his arc.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Bessy's account of the union committee's disciplined non-violence strategy provides essential social-historical context for the strike's escalation and Thornton's position.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's analysis of the failed strike — false premises, Irish replacements, broken solidarity — gives Blackstone the structural social critique he needs for this segment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Thornton's suppression of emotion through sharp business efficiency after his rejection is a masterclass in Gaskell's ironic narrative technique and his psychological complexity.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Wit, Warmth, and the Truth of Mrs. Gaskell's Humour
curation_assignments.rationale: Edith's comic struggle with the heavy tea kettle and Henry's amused observation deliver the domestic satire and character comedy Woodcourt needs.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Wit, Warmth, and the Truth of Mrs. Gaskell's Humour
curation_assignments.rationale: Higgins's wry observation that 'North and South has both met and made kind o' friends in this big smoky place' blends warmth, dialect comedy, and thematic irony.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Wit, Warmth, and the Truth of Mrs. Gaskell's Humour
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's satirical observation about London dinner guests lashing themselves into enthusiasm is Gaskell at her most pointed and comic — ideal for close reading.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Wit, Warmth, and the Truth of Mrs. Gaskell's Humour
curation_assignments.rationale: Higgins's defiant, comic declaration of northern workers' spirit — 'yo' may clem us, but yo'll not put upon us' — combines social critique with vivid dramatic comedy.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Working Man's Heart: Higgins, Solidarity, and the Cost of Principle
curation_assignments.rationale: Higgins's passionate moral argument that strikes are communal acts of justice, grounded in his support for Boucher, is the defining statement of his solidarity arc.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Working Man's Heart: Higgins, Solidarity, and the Cost of Principle
curation_assignments.rationale: Higgins's scriptural justification of union coercion as response to historical master oppression is his most philosophically rich and polemically charged speech.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Working Man's Heart: Higgins, Solidarity, and the Cost of Principle
curation_assignments.rationale: Higgins's refusal to take the employer's pledge against the Union, at personal cost, is the clearest embodiment of his principled class solidarity.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Working Man's Heart: Higgins, Solidarity, and the Cost of Principle
curation_assignments.rationale: Higgins seeking work solely to support Boucher's widow and children reveals the human cost and moral depth of solidarity beyond ideology.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Working Man's Heart: Higgins, Solidarity, and the Cost of Principle
curation_assignments.rationale: The union's total social ostracism mechanism — 'ten hours for three hundred days' — gives Blackstone the thematic_depth passage on institutional power he requires.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Architecture of Transformation: How Gaskell Builds Margaret's Becoming
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's anguished internal reckoning with her lie — 'of all faults the one she most despised was the want of bravery' — is a pivotal transformation moment rendered with ironic narrative technique.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Architecture of Transformation: How Gaskell Builds Margaret's Becoming
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's sudden consciousness of her own feelings for Thornton alongside her loss of womanhood is the psychological turning point Hartley needs for transformation analysis.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Architecture of Transformation: How Gaskell Builds Margaret's Becoming
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's private examination of her hidden feelings after her father's departure is rendered with Gaskell's characteristic free indirect discourse and narrative irony.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Architecture of Transformation: How Gaskell Builds Margaret's Becoming
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's meditation on pervasive change at Helstone — 'places were changed... a tree gone here' — externalises her internal transformation through landscape symbolism.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Architecture of Transformation: How Gaskell Builds Margaret's Becoming
curation_assignments.rationale: The candle burning in her old bedroom and the stars overhead give Hartley a rich passage on Gaskell's atmospheric symbolism and narrative technique of displacement.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Architecture of Transformation: How Gaskell Builds Margaret's Becoming
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's passionate defence of the South against Thornton's assertions is thematically dense and demonstrates Hartley's required narrative_technique and character_development.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Love and Justice: The Novel's Final Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Thornton's conviction that no formal institutions can bridge class divisions without personal intercourse is the ideological culmination of his arc and the novel's social argument.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Love and Justice: The Novel's Final Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's direct, affectionate gaze and Thornton's wondering response is the emotional resolution of her transformation arc, rendered with Gaskell's most delicate narrative touch.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Love and Justice: The Novel's Final Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's contemplative hours by the sea, where her internal transformation becomes visible in her appearance, give Woodcourt a tender character_development passage for the final segment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Love and Justice: The Novel's Final Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Thornton's revelation that he visited Helstone to see where Margaret grew into herself — 'even at the worst time of all, when I had no hope' — is the novel's most quotable love passage.

curation_assignments.segment_name: What North and South Still Asks of Us
curation_assignments.rationale: Thornton's transformation from merchant ideology to genuine sympathy with workers — 'we have all of us one human heart' — anchors the closing segment's social critique.

curation_assignments.segment_name: What North and South Still Asks of Us
curation_assignments.rationale: Thornton's description of mutual friendship and learning with workers provides the thematic depth the closing segment needs about the novel's enduring social vision.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Mill and the Mob: Thornton's Reckoning
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's observation of two mutually dependent classes treating each other as enemies fills the social critique structural gap for this segment with a concise, quotable insight.

curation_assignments.segment_name: What North and South Still Asks of Us
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's morning resolve to think of others' benefit rather than personal loss — 'if the world stood still, it would retrograde' — provides thematic depth for the closing.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Industrial Awakening: Margaret Enters the World
curation_assignments.rationale: Margaret's return home reflecting that Milton has become 'a place of human interest' fills the narrative technique structural gap and closes the opening segment with optimism.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Working Man's Heart: Higgins, Solidarity, and the Cost of Principle
curation_assignments.rationale: The revelation of Thornton's secret investigation on Higgins's behalf fills the character development structural gap while bridging the Higgins and Thornton arcs beautifully.
